title: Gurtydirty42
body:
Description


gurtydirty42 is a vinyl created by JohnmasterXx which plays r&b-esque music.

It could be purchased for $600 at Jer's Junkyard before the map change.

As of the map update, this vinyl can now be found at Lighthouse. It can be purchased via the front store and is located under the wooden roof on one of the brick pallets near the back right support beam.
